data.gender_notes: Jannahaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jannahaat is derived from the Arabic word 'Jannah' meaning 'Garden' or 'Paradise'. It is a beautiful name that reflects the concept of the Islamic belief in the Gardens of Paradise, a place of eternal peace and happiness for the righteous. The name Jannahaat carries the meaning “Gardens of Paradise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jannahaat usually hope their child will grow to embody gardens of paradise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jannahaat represents the spiritual journey towards the Gardens of Paradise, a place of eternal bliss and divine reward. It is a reminder of the importance of living a righteous life and striving for spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Jannahaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gardens of Paradise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jannahaat total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

Historically, names derived from this root have been popular across Muslim cultures for their positive connotations of peace, beauty, and spiritual reward.
